title: Dört Günlük Aktif Plan
subtitle: İki kısa tekrar günü; like / would like / be like ve possessive ’s ile iki yeni gün.

days.title: Present simple ile present continuous’ı ayır
days.intro: Derste “I usually go to work by car, but today I am going by bus” karşılaştırmasını yaptın. Zaman ifadesini ve eylemin devam edip etmediğini kontrol ederek doğru yapıyı seç.
days.remember: Genel alışkanlık ve gerçek → present simple. Şu anda veya geçici olarak devam eden eylem → am/is/are + verb-ing.
days.watchOut: Present continuous için yalnızca -ing yetmez; am/is/are mutlaka gerekir: I am working, not I working.

rules.title: Genel ve tekrar eden
rules.text: Usually, every day, often, on Saturdays gibi ifadeler present simple ile sık kullanılır.

rules.title: Şu an ve geçici
rules.text: Now, right now, at the moment ve today gibi geçici bağlamlarda present continuous kullan.
examples: I am taking the bus today.
They are working at the moment.

rules.title: Aynı cümlede karşıtlık
rules.text: Normal rutini simple, bugünkü istisnayı continuous ile karşılaştırabilirsin.
examples: I usually drink coffee, but today I am drinking tea.
He works at home, but this week he is working in the office.

words.example: I am working at the moment.
She is talking to a client right now.

words.definition: a series of actions continuing over time
words.example: The action is a process, not a finished point.

practice.prompt: I usually ___ coffee, but today I ___ tea.
practice.feedback: Routine uses simple; today’s action uses continuous.
Look signals an action happening now.

practice.prompt: She ___ at a hospital every weekday.

reading.title: A different Monday
paragraphs: Sefa normally works from home. He usually drinks coffee in the morning and answers messages before his first meeting.
Today is different. He is working in a shared office, and he is drinking tea. His colleagues are preparing a presentation, so everyone is talking quietly.

questions.feedback: The presentation preparation explains the quiet voices.

listening.title: Listen for actions happening now
listening.instructions: Dört konuşmayı dinle. İkinci dinlemede her am/is/are + -ing yapısını durdurup yaz.
listening.task: Duyduğun dört devam eden eylemi ve onları yapan kişileri eşleştir.
listening.followUp: Write two routine sentences and two “right now” sentences.

test.prompt: Every day, I ___ at nine.
test.hint: This is a routine.

test.prompt: Right now, I ___ a report.
test.hint: Use am + -ing.

test.prompt: She usually ___ by bus.
test.feedback: Usually signals present simple; she takes goes.
test.hint: Habit + third person.

test.prompt: Today she ___ by train.
test.feedback: Today is a temporary exception here.
test.hint: Use is + -ing.

test.prompt: They ___ at the moment.
test.feedback: At the moment takes are working.
test.hint: They uses are.

test.prompt: Choose the routine sentence.
test.hint: Find the regular time phrase.

test.prompt: Choose the action happening now.
test.feedback: Is reading now is in progress.
test.hint: Look for be + -ing and now.

test.prompt: Present continuous needs ___.
test.hint: Two parts are required.

test.prompt: Choose the correct sentence.
test.hint: Check both parts.

test.prompt: Which word means “normalde”?
test.hint: Think of the usual situation.

test.prompt: A change that will not last is ___.
test.hint: It has a limited duration.

test.prompt: I usually drink coffee, but today I ___ tea.
test.hint: Contrast the routine with now.

test.prompt: He works at home, but this week he ___ in the office.
test.feedback: This week is temporary in this context.
test.hint: Use is + -ing.

test.prompt: Which phrase most clearly signals now?
test.hint: The others signal habits.

test.prompt: Choose the best question for now.
options: What are you doing right now?
test.feedback: A current action uses are you doing.
test.hint: Move are before the subject.

days.title: Fiilin türünü ve zamanın anlamını birlikte kontrol et
days.intro: Son gün; kişilik sıfatlarını, present simple sorularını ve devam eden eylemleri aynı iş günü bağlamında birleştirir. Ayrıca derste giriş yaptığınız finished action / action in progress ayrımını yalnızca anlam düzeyinde tanıyacaksın.
days.remember: Önce ana fiili bul. Sonra şu soruyu sor: Bu bir durum/alışkanlık mı, şu an devam eden bir süreç mi, yoksa geçmişte tamamlanan bir olay mı?
days.watchOut: Never zaten olumsuz anlam taşır. Standart olumlu yapı kullan: I never go. “I don’t never go” çift olumsuz olur.

rules.title: Never ile tek olumsuzluk
rules.text: Never, fiilden önce gelir ve ayrıca don’t/doesn’t istemez.
examples: I never go to the library.

rules.title: Durum fiilleri
rules.text: Like, know, want ve have (sahip olmak) çoğunlukla durum bildirir; temel düzeyde present simple kullan.

rules.title: Geçmişte olay ve süreç
rules.text: Past simple tamamlanan olayı; past continuous belirli bir geçmiş anda devam eden süreci gösterir.
examples: We were playing basketball at six.

words.example: I never use a double negative.
Reading every evening is a useful habit.

words.definition: to keep happening or doing something
words.example: The meeting continued for an hour.

practice.feedback: Never already makes the meaning negative.
A specific past time inside an ongoing action uses were playing.
practice.hint: Focus on the action in progress.

practice.prompt: The receptionist helps everyone and speaks kindly. She is ___.

reading.title: A busy afternoon at work
paragraphs: Sefa usually works quietly, and his colleagues say he is helpful. He never interrupts people during meetings. Today the office is busier than usual because the team is preparing a new project.
At three yesterday, Sefa was explaining a problem when a client called. He finished the explanation, answered the call and then continued his work.

questions.feedback: His colleagues say he is helpful.

questions.prompt: Why is the office busy today?
options: The team is preparing a project.
questions.feedback: The team is preparing a new project.
questions.hint: Read the end of paragraph one.

questions.feedback: A client called while he was explaining.

listening.title: Listen for states and actions
listening.instructions: Dört konuşmayı dinle. Duyduğun look, sound, feel, smell, taste ve like örneklerini not al.
listening.task: Her durum fiilini yanındaki sıfat veya tamamlayıcıyla eşleştir.
listening.followUp: Write three true state sentences and one action happening now.

test.prompt: Choose the correct sentence with never.
test.hint: Avoid a double negative.

test.prompt: He never ___ late.
test.feedback: He takes arrives in present simple.
test.hint: Never does not remove third-person -s.

test.prompt: I ___ soup.
test.feedback: Like is normally a state in present simple.
test.hint: This is a preference, not an action process.

test.prompt: She ___ a question.
test.hint: She is third-person singular.

test.prompt: Right now, she ___ the client.
test.hint: Use is + -ing.

test.prompt: Every day, she ___ clients.
test.hint: She needs -s.

test.prompt: At six yesterday, we ___ basketball.
test.feedback: The time points inside an ongoing past action.
test.hint: Use past continuous.

test.prompt: Yesterday, we ___ basketball and went home.
test.feedback: This presents completed events in sequence.
test.hint: Use past simple.

test.prompt: Which adjective matches good manners?
test.hint: Think of please and thank you.

test.prompt: Which sentence is a present habit?
test.hint: Look for a repeated time.

test.prompt: Which sentence is happening now?
test.feedback: Are preparing now is current continuous.
test.hint: Look for now.

test.prompt: Does he ___ at home?
test.feedback: Use the base verb after does.
test.hint: The helper carries person information.

test.prompt: He doesn't ___ on Sundays.
test.feedback: Use the base verb after doesn’t.
test.hint: Remove -s from the main verb.

test.prompt: A process is something that ___.
test.feedback: A process develops or continues through time.
test.hint: Think of duration.

test.prompt: Best self-check before choosing a tense:
options: Find the main verb and the time meaning.
test.feedback: Verb type plus time meaning guides the choice.
test.hint: Use the lesson’s decision method.

days.title: like, would like ve be like
days.intro: Bugün üç farklı anlamı ayıracağız. Kısa örneklerle düşün ve cümlenin amacını bul.
days.remember: Genel beğeni: like. Kibar istek: would like. Birinin nasıl olduğunu sormak/anlatmak: be like.
days.watchOut: would like fiilden önce gelirse to gerekir: I would like to watch. like sonrasında verb-ing veya to + verb kullanılabilir.

rules.title: like
examples: I like to read before bed.

rules.title: would like
rules.text: Şu anki veya kibar bir isteği anlatır.
examples: I would like to watch a film.

rules.title: be like
rules.text: Bir kişinin veya şeyin nasıl olduğunu sorar/anlatır.

practice.hint: Kuralı veya metni yeniden kontrol et.
Kuralı veya metni yeniden kontrol et.

options: I would like watch a film.
I would like to watch a film.
I like to watching a film.
practice.hint: Kuralı veya metni yeniden kontrol et.
Kuralı veya metni yeniden kontrol et.
Kuralı veya metni yeniden kontrol et.

reading.title: A Simple Friday Choice
paragraphs: On Friday evening, Murat usually meets his friend Deniz. Murat likes quiet cafés, but Deniz prefers walking in the park. This week the weather is warm, so Murat says, “I would like to walk first and have tea later.” Deniz likes the idea.

Deniz is friendly and energetic, while Murat is calm and careful. They are different, but they enjoy spending time together. After the walk, Murat would like to try a new café. Deniz agrees because he likes discovering new places.

questions.hint: Kuralı veya metni yeniden kontrol et.

questions.prompt: What would he like to do first?
questions.hint: Kuralı veya metni yeniden kontrol et.
Kuralı veya metni yeniden kontrol et.

days.title: Possessive ’s ile kime ait olduğunu söyle
days.intro: Bir kişi veya canlıya ait şeyi anlatırken isimden sonra ’s kullanırız. Bu gün aynı zamanda önceki konuları kısa bir bağlamda karıştırır.
days.remember: Tekil kişi + ’s + şey: Ayşe’s brother. Çoğul -s ile bitiyorsa yalnız apostrof: my parents’ house.
days.watchOut: his/her ile ’s yapısını karıştırma: her brother = onun erkek kardeşi; Elif’s brother = Elif’in erkek kardeşi.

rules.title: Tekil isim + ’s
examples: My aunt’s son is my cousin.

rules.title: Aile ilişkileri
rules.text: Bir kişiden diğerine bağlantıyı sahiplik yapısıyla kur.
examples: My sister’s daughter is my niece.
My brother’s son is my nephew.

rules.title: Karma tekrar
rules.text: like ve would like ile sahipliği aynı bağlamda kullan.
examples: My grandparents would like to visit us.

words.definition: a child of your aunt or uncle
words.example: My aunt’s son is my cousin.
My sister’s son is my nephew.
My brother’s daughter is my niece.

words.definition: one of two children born together
parents of your mother or father

reading.title: A Family Lunch
paragraphs: Sefa’s cousin Emre usually organises a family lunch once a month. Emre’s wife likes cooking, and their twin children enjoy helping her. This Sunday, Sefa’s aunt and uncle would like to bring dessert. His grandparents prefer tea after lunch.

The family is large, so everyone has a small job. Emre’s niece prepares the table, and his nephew chooses the music. Sefa likes quiet music, but the children would like to hear something lively. In the end, they choose both and enjoy the afternoon together.
